mapper.sql: id, create_time, update_time, create_user_name, create_user_id, update_user_name, update_user_id, version, is_deleted, platform_code, name, asin, msku, fn_sku, sku_no, product_name, delivery_channels, fbm_fulfillable_qty, inbound_working_qty, inbound_shipped_qty, inbound_receiving_qty, fulfillable_qty, reserved_qty, researching_qty, unsellable_qty, inventory_age
mapper.select:
SELECT fi.id, fi.fba_shipment_id, fi.warehouse_id, fi.warehouse_name, fi.asin, fi.msku, fi.fn_sku, fi.sku_no, fi.product_name, fi.delivery_channels, fi.fbm_fulfillable_qty, fi.inbound_working_qty, fi.inbound_shipped_qty, fi.inbound_receiving_qty, fi.fulfillable_qty, fi.reserved_qty, fi.researching_qty, fi.unsellable_qty, fi.inventory_age_0_to_30_days, fi.inventory_age_31_to_60_days, fi.inventory_age_61_to_90_days, fi.inventory_age_91_to_180_days, fi.inventory_age_181_to_270_days, fi.inventory_age_271_to_365_days, fi.inventory_age_365_plus_days, fi.update_time as updateTime, fi.create_time as createTime FROM fba_inventory fi WHERE ${params.sqlMap.default} and fi.is_deleted = FALSE
AND fi.warehouse_id in
#{warehouseId}
AND fi.asin ILIKE concat('%',#{params.asin}::text,'%')
AND fi.fn_sku ILIKE concat('%',#{params.fnSku}::text,'%')
AND fi.msku ILIKE concat('%',#{params.msku}::text,'%')
AND fi.delivery_channels in
#{deliveryChannels}
AND fi.update_time >= #{params.updateTimeList[0]} and (#{params.updateTimeList[1]}::TIMESTAMP + INTERVAL '1 DAY' ) > fd.update_time
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT id FROM fba_inventory f WHERE f.id = fi.id AND fi.fbm_fulfillable_qty = 0 AND fi.inbound_working_qty = 0 AND fi.inbound_shipped_qty = 0 AND fi.inbound_receiving_qty = 0 AND fi.fulfillable_qty = 0 AND fi.reserved_qty = 0 AND fi.researching_qty = 0 AND fi.unsellable_qty = 0)
${params.permissionSql}
ORDER BY
${item.field} ${item.sort}
fi.create_time DESC
